methodology: Local uncompressed HTTP, ephemeral port; synthetic clean browser contexts; no authored recipe edits. Viewports emulate layout only, not physical devices. Performance uses 3 fresh contexts per viewport, service workers blocked to isolate startup resources, no CPU/network throttling. Search/open metrics are browser event-to-next-paint lab latency, not field INP. LCP/CLS sampled after initial app readiness plus 500 ms. Screenshots are viewport captures unless content is indicated.
